output_list.code: function addToken(address invest,uint256 value){    if(msg.sender!=master)throw;    balances[invest]+=value;    totalTokens+=value;}
output_list.reason: The addToken function allows the creation of new tokens, which will be distributed to the ICO participants. The function does not use any randomness mechanism and it just adds the given value of tokens to the total tokens. If a malicious person calls this function with a very large value of 'value', they will be able to create large number of tokens in a fraction of time, thereby creating a lot of artificial tokens for the ICO. If the function would use randomness to generate tokens, the number of tokens for the malicious person would be significantly reduced.
